title: Is this 737-8 Cockpit overhaul worth it? | MSFS 2020 marketplace review
description:
Are you looking to enhance your Microsoft Flight Simulator airliner experience this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a focused commercial aviation marketplace feature targeting your primary workspace in the flightdeck.

To find out what's worth your hard-earned money, we dive into the latest release from 2Pilot: the New Cockpit 737-8 texture overhaul for MSFS 2020. Designed specifically for the Microsoft / Working Title Boeing 737-8, this cosmetic pack replaces the clean, sterile stock interior surfaces with redefined instrument surrounds, updated glare shields, refined color grading, and realistic wear-and-tear weathering.

Whether you log significant hours cruising in the 737-8 MAX or just want a sharper, more lived-in atmosphere in the front office, we evaluate the texture quality, visual ambience, and overall value proposition at its launch discount to help you decide if it deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar! Are you keeping the original stock 737-8 textures, or will you be switching to this visual overhaul?
